$comment: Capability class to model mapping (owner, 2026-11-17). The protected policy names classes; this file names the models, so replacing a model that disappeared is one edit here instead of a protected-document review. Keep three candidates per class, the metered rungs last, and refresh that class's `probedAt` date when a round probes its first candidate. A candidate observed unavailable twice in a day is replaced at the round's end (policy: Seat health is probed once per round); two consecutive days makes that the owner's decision.

notes.git-executor: Only one free candidate exists today (`opencode/beam-free`), so the second and third rungs are metered; that is the gap the 2026-11-17 ruling names - a free provider exhausted twice in a day is replaced at the round's end, not retried all day.
notes.mock-builder: Default `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` (owner, 2026-11-17) for building and re-cutting mocks under `mockups/`; it sits in `anyWindow` because a mock cut is not clock-sensitive.
notes.probe: One dispatch per class per local day, at round open; the outcome is recorded in that round's Seats table and holds until the next day.
notes.insideWindow: 12:00-18:00 local moves the worker, grill and reviewer classes; the git executor is not clocked.
